name: Midnight Studio Original Horror Lab
art_style: Simplified thick-outlined 2D cartoon horror, flat colors, consistent anonymous protagonist with dark raincoat and obscured face, cinematic composition, muted navy and amber palette

episodes.title: The Hallway That Counted
episodes.setting: a deserted basement of an old hotel with numbered storage doors
episodes.threat: a shadow that only moves between door numbers
episodes.lead: a nameless night porter wearing a dark raincoat
episodes.hook: the door numbers begin counting backward
episodes.twist: the porter is listed as the next missing room

episodes.title: The Elevator Refused the Lobby
episodes.setting: a silent elevator inside an unoccupied downtown tower
episodes.threat: a figure that appears inside reflections but never in the elevator
episodes.lead: the same nameless night porter wearing a dark raincoat
episodes.hook: the elevator buttons light up before they are touched
episodes.twist: each floor is the same room at a different hour

episodes.title: The Doors That Remember
episodes.setting: a vacant roadside hotel with hallways that rearrange after midnight
episodes.threat: an unseen figure moving between identical locked rooms
episodes.lead: a weary night clerk with short dark hair, full beard, charcoal jacket, dark trousers
episodes.hook: security footage shows a door opening from the inside even though no one entered
episodes.twist: every exit returns the clerk to the first room, and the hotel is using his memories to remake the halls
